owner.how: new Mover(config, octree, {events, owner: "p1"}); mover.reset(x, y, z); never stepped (only the loadout steps)

loadout.how: createLoadout(config, owner, {octree, enemies, orbs}, events, options); loadout.setOwned(owned)

cases.note: The railcannon (config.weapons.rail): aim from (0, 1, 0) along -z. Fire held: railCharge, then the full charge fires by itself (unzoomed: no owner.ads), piercing enemies 1, 2 (killed) and 3; enemy 4 stands behind the wall at z = -30 and is not hit. Fire stays held through the cooldown (no second charge), then released; no input until the cooldown ends; a charge released before full (railCancel); a second full charge fires after the cooldown.

owner.how: new Mover(config, octree, {events, owner: "p1"}); mover.reset(x, y, z); never stepped (only the loadout steps)

loadout.how: createLoadout(config, owner, {octree, enemies, orbs}, events, options); loadout.setOwned(owned)

cases.note: The rail's special (config.weapons.specials.rail): special held from a standstill overcharges (railCharge {over: true}) and fires by itself when full: x damageMult on enemy 1, the wall at z = -30 stops it, the kick back lands in the Mover velocity (+z). Special stays held a little (blocked), released; no input through the longer cooldown; the velocity is set to 40 m/s along the aim near its end, so aimMomentum() passes config.momentum.variantAt: the next full charge is the momentum variant, through both walls (z = -30 and z = -40) to enemies 2 and 3 behind them (momentum also scales its damage).
